senses.gloss: there is, there are (sunt qui). א׳ דאמרי (abbrev. א״ד.) some say.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 3b">Ḥull. 3ᵇ</cite>; a. fr. <he>א׳ בינייהו</he> they differ in this &c.
<cite ref="Chullin 4a:17">Ib. 4ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.—<he>מאי א׳ למימר</he> what is there to say? how can it be explained? what can you reply? <cite ref="Chullin 12a:1">Ib. 12ᵃ</cite> top; a. fr.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 19:7">Targ. Prov. XIX, 7</cite>. [Prob. to be read <cite ref="A01366"><he>אִינָא</he></cite>.]
